dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: Ah, so you've remembered it, eh? Well, that makes one more young person who knows it. Good, good.

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: "Rose, oh rose, grant me my wish. Blooming from the stone, the Golden Rose sang to me."

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: "No land but folk songs bore my spirit. Songs shall defy my fate, and overcome my destiny."

dialogues.speaker: Affan
dialogues.text: "They will surpass me, surpass time. They will surpass the ever-lasting withering of life..."
